name: Kamiwaza
description: Direct Kamiwaza MCP tool bridge for local platform deployments.

apiUrl.label: Kamiwaza API URL
apiUrl.help: Kamiwaza platform API base URL, for example https://host.lima.internal/api.

apiToken.label: Kamiwaza PAT
apiToken.help: Kamiwaza personal access token. Fallbacks: KAMIWAZA_API_KEY, then the local Kamiwaza PAT credential store.

credentialStorePath.label: Kamiwaza PAT Store
credentialStorePath.help: Optional OpenClaw-side PAT store written by sync-kamiwaza-pat-credentials.sh, or a raw pdash-pat-store-v1 export.

genericTool.label: Expose Generic Kamiwaza Tool
genericTool.help: When true, registers kamiwaza_call as a direct fallback bridge.

verifyTls.label: Verify Kamiwaza TLS
verifyTls.help: When false, direct Kamiwaza calls accept the local platform gateway's self-signed certificate.

delegation.signingSecret.label: Delegation Signing Secret
delegation.signingSecret.help: Optional secret for signed delegated agent identity headers on Kamiwaza tool calls.

delegation.required.label: Require Delegated Identity
delegation.required.help: When true, direct Kamiwaza calls fail closed unless a signed agent identity can be attached.
